connector.name: Mundane
connector.registryDescription: Hire verified, escrow-paid humans for real-world tasks: errands, photos, queues, bookings.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mundane-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace market.mundane, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MUNDANE_API_KEY
env.description: Agent API key from POST /v1/agents/signup. Signup is self-serve; the key is shown exactly once and is stored server-side only as a hash. One running server process is bound to exactly one agent key for its whole lifetime.

env.name: MUNDANE_API_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the Mundane REST API. Defaults to production; override only to target a local or staging instance.
